title: Hello World
description: Clear the screen, set colours and print text with the KERNAL routine CHROUT. Shows the BASIC start line, constants and a simple loop.

title: Raster Bars (border + background)
description: Colour bars that move through border and background by changing $D020/$D021 on every raster line. Explains bad lines and uses the FLD trick.

title: Soft Scroller
description: A smooth text scroller using $D016 fine scrolling, two raster interrupts per frame and colour RAM cycling.

title: Sprite Animation
description: Eight spinning coins fly in a circle. Sprite graphics are generated by ACME maths, the 9th X bit ($D010) and sprite pointers are explained.

title: Sprite Scroller
description: A big waving text scroller made of 8 expanded sprites. Reads the character ROM and shifts bits with ASL/ROL in unrolled loops.

title: Simple Plasma
description: Colour RAM plasma: colour(x,y) = palette[sin(x) + sin(y)]. Shows precalculation and indirect indexed addressing.

title: Complex Plasma
description: Five sine waves, a custom dither character set (Bayer matrix generated by ACME) and self-modifying code.

title: Rotating 3D Square
description: A square tumbling in 3D, drawn with Bresenham lines into a double buffered charset canvas. The 3D maths runs inside ACME.

title: SID Player 1x / 2x / 3x
description: Plays a SID tune with 1, 2 or 3 raster interrupts per frame, shows name/author/released from the PSID header and a raster time meter.

title: Koala Picture Viewer (.kla)
description: Displays a multicolour bitmap in Koala format: VIC bank switching via $DD00, $D018 and multicolour bitmap mode.

title: Raster Split (three zones)
description: One table-driven raster interrupt splits the screen into three zones with their own border, background and character set ($D018).

title: Parallax Starfield
description: 23 stars at three speeds move pixel by pixel on a character screen: copying the ROM charset, redefining characters, 16-bit X positions.

title: DYCP Scroller
description: Every letter bounces on its own sine wave. The letters are drawn into a 40 x 3 character canvas; $D016 smooth scrolling and an unrolled copy loop.

title: Character Fire
description: A burning fire over the whole screen: SID noise as random generator, a heat buffer and a dither charset generated by ACME.

title: Colour Cycling Text
description: A text page whose colours flow like a wave - only the colour RAM changes. Notewriter style from the old demos.

title: Joystick Controlled Sprite
description: Move a sprite with a joystick in port 2 ($DC00), keep it on screen, detect fire presses, print the position in hex and play a sound.

title: Random Maze (10 PRINT)
description: The famous one-line maze in machine code. Compares an 8-bit and a 16-bit LFSR random generator - you can see the 8-bit one repeat.

title: Key Codes: Hex, Dec, Bin
description: Shows the code of every key you press in hex, decimal (BCD with SED) and binary, plus the screen code. Number conversions every coder needs.

title: Open Top and Bottom Border
description: The classic border trick: switch to 24 rows at line 249 and sprites become visible in the upper and lower border.

title: Hires Bitmap Plot
description: 320 x 200 bitmap mode, a fast plot routine with tables, a coordinate system and two function curves drawn pixel by pixel.
